summary: v9 items 4+5 implemented in the 6 in-scope files (+ new PipSection.tsx). (ITEM 4, images off) The images-off state is now legible and complete without relabelling the audited button text: the store gained SECTION_UNDERLAY_KIND_DESCRIPTIONS (the 'Simulated only (no imagery): draw the simulated section and nothing external' sentence) and IMAGERY_OFF_STATEMENT / PIP_IMAGERY_WITHHELD_STATEMENT as the ONE wording used by PlatesTab's state line, the modality buttons' accessible name (aria-label, which contains the visible label -> WCAG 2.5.3 holds), the panel's own window line and Viewer3D's hint. The 4 call sites that match the button by EXACT text (audit.mjs:656/716, checks.mjs:523, browser-probe.mjs:274 - two of those scripts are owned by no v9 task) are why the label stays 'Simulated only'; that deviation from PLAN 5.4 is documented in the store and in this report. The off-state note no longer reads as a coverage excuse and now names both surfaces and the persistence. Persistence is unchanged (neuroaxis.sectionUnderlay, schemaVersion 2, already written by setSectionUnderlay) and is asserted. (ITEM 5, PiP -> simulated-section panel) SectionPiP.tsx was rewritten from 1,706 lines / 81,127 B to 717 lines / ~33 kB: the in-canvas renderer, the private ortho camera + WebGLRenderTarget, the stencil parity + cap passes, the MSAA/parity watchdog, the ?pipdebug overlay, the scissored blit, the real-slice backdrop sampler and the PiP context-loss mirror are all DELETED (probe asserts none of 23 retired tokens survives in code; grep-verified that no other module referenced any of them, so nothing was left mounted with no purpose). The panel now renders <PipSection> (new, 148 lines) = its own SectionErrorBoundary + the SAME SectionCanvas the Plates tab mounts (one code path, PLAN 0a), so it shows the worker-clipped simulated section - no 3D cut, no plane helper, no real imagery. Two structural guarantees make 'no real imagery, ever, whatever the Plates-tab modality' true: (a) a reference-counted, non-persisting imagery scope (beginSectionPipImageryScope) holds the store in the kind:'none' state while the panel's canvas is mounted - the user's own choice on disk is never rewritten (0 writes asserted) and is restored on unmount; (b) an unconditional pixel guard shadows drawImage/putImageData on that canvas' own context only (imageLayers.ts puts every real-imagery blit through exactly those two calls: ctx.drawImage x4, c2d.putImageData x1 - read out of the source by the probe), counting what it drops. The window is resizable: a real named <button> corner handle (pointer drag + arrow keys, Shift x4) plus the small->large cycle, written to the new persisted store field sectionPipSize (neuroaxis.sectionPipSize, JSON, clamped on read AND write to [224,880]x[170,640] by the exported clampSectionPipSize: 20/20 candidates inside bounds, idempotent, integral). Size travels to CSS as the custom properties --pip-window-width/-height so the <=900px media query can still override the box; .pip-small/.pip-large stay as the CSS fallback. Chrome kept: axis override (X/Y/Z + aria-pressed), plane readout in the audited 'x = 12.0 au' shape, the 4 L/R/A/P/S/I badges (patient-left), hide (title 'Hide live section'), the restore pill (Live section >), the .pip-toggle narrow-viewport tab with its exact a11y literals. The main canvas context-loss overlay is untouched (closure-bite anchor data-context-lost={phase} intact). VERIFICATION (all run here): npm run check exit 0; npm run build exit 0; npm run validate 0/0; npm run verify:pipeline 138/138 parts / 599,204 tris / 0 problems; npm run verify:plane PASSED 10,827 assertions; boundary-contract 22/22; a11y-contract 38/38; budget-report PASSED; build-anatomy-geometry --manifest PASS; verify-imaging-v4 PASSED; -v4b OK; node .dsh-scratch/section-ux-probe.mjs 75 passed / 0 failed (store fields+persistence+clamp 20 sizes, imagery scope, panel markup rendered with react-dom/server, per-axis badges vs PLANE_BADGES, retirement, drawImage guard incl. a second canvas staying untouched, imagery chokepoints). ORCHESTRATOR-VERIFIED ONLY (Chrome denied in this sandbox): that the panel actually paints the section in a page, that a drag survives a reload, that the guard drops pixels live, that no plane helper is on screen.
